values.value: Data Manager is the one place for data tasks. Choose a card to Find and Export Records, Import a File or Update Many Records. Delete Many Records is the last card and asks you to confirm first. Import is a guided wizard with a step path, cards for what you are importing, a trial run and a results file. Find and Bulk Update have a cleaner layout and menus for saving, exporting and changing records. Org Optimizer is the one name for the data quality tool, with its checks grouped in a Data Quality section. Duplicate Matching shows each pair of possible duplicates side by side, with Merge and Not a Duplicate on the card. Matching rules have an Active switch and Show Details. BarnCRM Settings is grouped with icons and help popovers. A save bar stays in view, and every setting shows its default. The Setup Checklist and first run are easier to follow, with progress rings and one step count. Home shows Health Check and other status tiles with badges and quick links. Household and address panels have member tiles, address cards and clear empty states. Saving records is faster: address changes, household updates, rollups and gift allocations do less work on every save. Every tab has its own icon. Labels are shorter, links that open in a new tab say so, and Error Log is always the last tab.
A simpler way to work with your data, plus faster saves
